S17 (8.4 s)
Emotion/story 2 · Sound-off 3 · Pacing 2 · Composition 3

1. 2.5–5.9 s: The 2000s stack reaches full height by 2.5 s, but its label only shows up somewhere between 4.2 and 5.9 s. "Fourteen thousand" is spoken at 4.3 s. That leaves about 3 s where nothing changes. Fix: make the stack grow more slowly so it finishes on "same" at 3.3 s. Pop the label at 4.3 s.
2. 2.5–7.5 s: Nothing in the picture says the two stacks are "about the same," and the frames look nearly identical. Fix: draw the dashed level line from the top of the 1990s stack over to the 2000s stack here, at about 3.3 s, instead of waiting until S18. Then S18 can reuse it.
3. 1.1–1.5 s: "With lower rates" has no visual. The blue line in the 2000s section looks the same as the 1990s section. Fix: brighten or thicken the 2000s part of the rate line and dip it slightly on "lower."
4. Whole scene: The tall amber rate-history bars behind the stacks are 2–3 times taller than the stacks, so they compete with them for height. The tall stack at the far left (x≈310) has no label, so it reads as a fourth amount. Fix: dim the background bars to about 30% and set the unlabeled stack back or remove it.

S18 (8.8 s)
Emotion/story 2 · Sound-off 3 · Pacing 3 · Composition 3

1. 1.2–2.0 s: The brief asks for the rate line to drop sharply, but it stays almost flat. The new stack also sits right on top of the line and breaks it in the 2010s section. Fix: push the stack forward or lift the line above it. Animate a visible downward step on "far lower."
2. 2.8–4.4 s: The dashed comparison line shows up at about 4.4 s, after "yet…cost more" (2.8–4.0 s). The surprise beat lands late. Fix: snap the dashed line on at 3.0 s and have the stack visibly grow up past it.
3. 4.8–6.1 s: The large header and the stack label both show $20,374, and both appear somewhere between 4.4 and 6.1 s. The number is shown twice. Fix: use a single label, timed to "twenty" at 4.8 s, and move the rate figure (4.03%) next to the line.
4. Emotion: Tessa never reacts in either scene, so the irony that lower rates came with a higher cost never reaches a person. Fix: have Tessa turn toward the 2010s stack, or step back as it rises past the dashed line. Also move her "Tessa · ILLUSTRATIVE" tag so it no longer covers the house and the base of the first stack.
